title: Josephus Deep Bloodlines (Esau → Agag → Haman, Herod → Armenia/Cilicia/Rome, Sparta–Abraham Charter & Cleodemus–Heracles) + Intercultural Alias Atlas

nodes.name: King Agag of Amalek (1 Sam 15; Josephus Ant. VI.7 pp.339–342)
nodes.role: Amalekite Monarch Descended from Esau → Eliphaz → Amalek
nodes.notes: Captured by King Saul and executed by Samuel; Pseudo-Philo Ch. 58 & Rabbinic Targum record Agag siring an heir before death whose line produced Haman the Agagite.

nodes.name: Haman ben Hammedatha the Agagite/Amalekite (+ Wife Zeresh & 10 Sons, Josephus Ant. XI.6.5)
nodes.era: 5th c. BCE (Susa / Persia — Josephus Ant. XI.6.5 p.618)
nodes.role: Grand Vizier of Xerxes I / Agagite-Amalekite Descendant of Esau
nodes.notes: Josephus explicitly calls Haman 'by birth an Amalekite' (Ant. XI.6.5) — connecting Esau's grandson Amalek and King Agag straight into the Achaemenid Persian court opposite Benjaminite Mordecai & Queen Esther! Sons: Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha, Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha, Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai & Vaizatha.

nodes.name: Herod the Great's Remaining 5 Wives & Children (Josephus Ant. XVII.1.3): Pallas (→ Phasael II), Phaedra (→ Roxane), Elpis (→ Salome II), Niece & Cousin
nodes.role: Complete 10-Wife Roster of Herod the Great
nodes.notes: Completes Josephus's full inventory of Herod the Great's ten wives and their offspring: Pallas (Phasael II), Phaedra (Roxane), Elpis (Salome II), plus his unnamed niece and cousin.

nodes.name: Herodian Kings of Armenia & Cilicia (Josephus Ant. XVIII.5.4): Alexander + Glaphyra → Kings Tigranes V & Tigranes VI of Armenia → Gaius Julius Alexander (+ Iotape) → Roman Consuls
nodes.era: c. 15 BCE – 115 CE (Josephus Ant. XVII.1, XVIII.5.4 p.1196)
nodes.role: Esau/Idumean & Hasmonean Royal Bloodline Ruling Armenia, Cilicia & Entering Roman Senate
nodes.notes: Herod's son Alexander (+ Cappadocian princess Glaphyra, also widow of King Juba II of Mauretania!) fathered King Tigranes V of Armenia and Alexander II -> King Tigranes VI of Armenia -> King Gaius Julius Alexander of Cetis/Cilicia (+ Iotape of Commagene!) -> Roman suffect consuls Julius Agrippa & Julius Alexander Berenicianus!

nodes.name: Herodian–Roman–Emesa Marriages (Josephus Ant. XX.7): Berenice II (+ Emperor Titus & Polemon II), Drusilla (+ Azizus of Emesa & Felix → Agrippa, d. 79 CE Vesuvius!) & Mariamne
nodes.role: Final Herodian Intermarriages With Emesa, Cilicia & Flavian Rome
nodes.notes: Herod Agrippa I's daughters carried the Idumean-Hasmonean bloodline across the Roman Empire: Queen Berenice II (+ Marcus Julius Alexander, Herod of Chalcis, King Polemon II of Pontus & future Roman Emperor Titus!), and Drusilla (+ King Azizus of Emesa, then Roman Procurator Felix -> son Agrippa, who perished at Pompeii in the 79 CE eruption of Mt. Vesuvius!).

nodes.name: Esau / Edom = Rome & Byzantium Cross-Tradition Bridge (Josephus, Talmud, Jasher 60–61 Zepho/Janus & Al-Tabari Banu al-Asfar)
nodes.role: Classical Jewish & Islamic Identification of Rome/Byzantium With Esau (Edom)
nodes.notes: Explains why Jewish, Sefer ha-Yashar (Zepho/Janus king of Kittim/Rome), and early Islamic (Banu al-Asfar / al-Rum descended from Esau) traditions link Rome and Byzantium spiritually and genealogically to Esau.

nodes.name: King Areus I of Sparta → High Priest Onias (1 Macc 12:21; Josephus Ant. XII.4.10): Spartans & Jews Brethren From Abraham!
nodes.era: c. 309–265 BCE (1 Macc 12:20–23; Josephus Ant. XII.4.10)
nodes.role: Diplomatic Blood-Brotherhood Charter Linking Sparta Directly to Abraham
nodes.notes: Both 1 Maccabees 12 and Josephus Ant. XII.4.10 preserve King Areus I of Sparta's official sealed letter to High Priest Onias in Jerusalem declaring: 'It has been found in writing that the Spartans and the Jews are brethren, and that they are of the stock of Abraham!' Graduates classical Sparta into Biblically Connected!

nodes.name: Spartan Royal Houses (Agiad & Eurypontid): Lawgiver Lycurgus → King Leonidas I (Thermopylae, 480 BCE) → Agesilaus II → Cleomenes III
nodes.role: Kings & Lawgiver of Lacedaemon (Graduated via Abraham–Sparta Charter!)
nodes.notes: Moved out of Pending Bridge via the explicit Abraham-descent claim attested in 1 Maccabees 12:21 and Josephus Ant. XII.4.10, uniting Lawgiver Lycurgus, Leonidas I (+ Queen Gorgo), Agesilaus II, and Agiad King Areus I.

nodes.name: Josephus Ant. I.15 (Cleodemus Malchus): Abraham + Keturah → Epher / Apher ('Africa') → Heracles Weds Abraham's Granddaughter → Diodorus → Sophax (Mauretania / Juba II)
nodes.era: Patriarchal → African-Greek Mythic Horizon (Josephus Ant. I.15 p.102)
nodes.role: Oldest Quoted Greek-Jewish Bloodline Bridging Abraham, Heracles & North Africa
sources: Flavius Josephus Antiquities I.15 (quoting Alexander Polyhistor / Cleodemus Malchus)
nodes.notes: Josephus Ant. I.15 cites Hellenistic Jewish historian Cleodemus Malchus: Abraham's sons by Keturah (Epher/Apher, Asshur & Japhran) conquered Libya — giving AFRICA its name from Apher — and Heracles wed Apher's daughter, siring Diodorus -> Sophax (ancestor of King Juba II & Cleopatra Selene of Mauretania!).

nodes.name: Princess Tharbis of Ethiopia (Meroe/Saba) — Wife of General Moses (Josephus Ant. II.10 pp.152–154)
nodes.role: Ethiopian Royal Daughter Married to Moses During Nile Campaign
nodes.notes: Josephus recounts how Moses commanded Egypt's army against Ethiopia using stork/ibis baskets against serpents, besieged Saba (Meroe), and wed Ethiopian royal princess Tharbis (matching the 'Cushite woman' of Numbers 12:1).

nodes.name: Royal House of Adiabene (Assyria/Kurdistan, Josephus Ant. XX.2–4): King Monobazus I + Queen Helena → King Izates II & Monobazus II
nodes.role: Mesopotamian Royal Converts to Judaism Buried in Jerusalem
nodes.notes: King Monobazus I (Bazeus) and Queen Helena of Adiabene (ancient Assyria/Erbil) and their son King Izates II converted to Judaism, fed Jerusalem during the famine of Acts 11:28, and built the monumental Tomb of the Kings in Jerusalem.

nodes.name: Intercultural Aliases of Abraham: Abram / Ibrahim (Arabic) / Berossus's 10th Chaldean / Cleodemus's Africa-Heracles / Spartan Kinsman / Brahma-Syncretic
nodes.role: Unified Alias Index Across Hebrew, Arabic, Greek, Babylonian & Indian Traditions
nodes.notes: Maps how Abraham appears across world traditions: Hebrew Abram/Abraham; Arabic Prophet Ibrahim (Ibn Kathir / Sirah); Berossus's 'righteous Chaldean skilled in heavenly lore' (Ant. I.7.2); Cleodemus's grandfather-in-law of Heracles & ancestor of Africa (Ant. I.15); Spartan kindred charter (1 Macc 12:21); and 17th-c. folkloric comparison of Abraham/Sarah <-> Brahma/Saraswati.

nodes.name: Intercultural Aliases of Moses: Moshe / Musa (Arabic) / Osarseph (Manetho) / Musaeus (Artapanus) / King of Cush (Jasher 73) / Husband of Tharbis (Josephus)
nodes.role: Unified Alias Index Across Bible, Egypt, Greece, Nubia & Arabia
sources: Josephus Ant. II.10 & Against Apion I.26
nodes.notes: Unites Moses's names across ancient accounts: Hebrew Moshe; Quranic Prophet Musa; Egyptian priest-chronicler Manetho's Osarseph; Greco-Jewish Artapanus's Musaeus (teacher of Orpheus & Hermes); Book of Jasher's 40-year King of Cush (+ Adoniah); and Josephus's victorious Egyptian general (+ Tharbis).

nodes.name: Intercultural Aliases of Noah: Noach / Nuh / Ziusudra (Sumer) / Utnapishtim (Atrahasis) / Xisuthros (Berossus) / Vaivasvata Manu (India) / Yima (Iran) / Deucalion (Greece) / Janus / Fuxi (Figurist)
nodes.role: Global Cognate & Parallel Hub Linking Humanity After the Deluge
nodes.notes: Side-by-side comparison showing Noah's exact equivalents/parallels: Sumerian Ziusudra, Akkadian Atrahasis/Utnapishtim, Berossus's Xisuthros, Indian Vaivasvata Manu, Avestan Yima, Greek Deucalion & Ogyges, 18th-c. Janus/Oenotrus (Betham/Anderson), and Jesuit Figurist Fuxi.

nodes.name: Intercultural Aliases of Enoch: Khanokh / Idris (Arabic) / Hermes Trismegistus / Thoth (Egypt) / King Saurid (Pyramid Builder) / Enmeduranki (7th Sage)
nodes.notes: Tracks how the 7th Patriarch Enoch (inventor of writing & calendar in Jubilees 4:17) is identified in Coptic-Arabic chronicles with King Saurid (builder of Great Pyramids), in Hermeticism with Thoth/Hermes Trismegistus, in Islam with Prophet Idris, and compared structurally with Enmeduranki of Sippar.

nodes.name: Intercultural Aliases of Nimrod: Nebrod / Belus (Babylon) / Ninus (Assyria) / Al-Dahhak (Shahnameh) / Lamurudu (Yoruba Oduduwa Chronicle) / Orion
nodes.role: Near Eastern, Persian & West African Royal Syncretisms
sources: Samuel Johnson History of the Yorubas
nodes.notes: Maps Nimrod son of Cush across chronicles: Latin Vulgate/Dutripon Belus; classical Ninus of Nineveh; Persian/Arabic tyrants Zuhhak/Al-Dahhak (Tabari); and West African Yoruba chronicle ancestor Lamurudu -> Oduduwa.

nodes.name: Intercultural Aliases of Joseph & Solomon: Zaphenath-Paneah / Yusuf / Imhotep Parallel; Sulayman / King of Tadmor-Palmyra / Father of Menelik I (Ethiopia)
nodes.era: Egyptian Vizier & Near Eastern Sovereign Matrix
nodes.notes: Collects Joseph's Egyptian court title Zaphenath-Paneah (Arabic Yusuf, and 7-year-famine vizier parallel to Djoser's Imhotep) alongside Solomon (Sulayman), revered across Jerusalem, Aksumite Ethiopia (Menelik I), Yemen (Sheba/Bilqis), and Tadmor/Palmyra.
